description: Figure 8 presents a line plot illustrating the evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models. The x-axis represents the length, which is the sum of prefill length and generation length, and the y-axis represents the GPU memory usage in GB of the KV cache. The plot includes three lines, each representing a different method: Accelerate, DeepSpeed, and H2O. The Accelerate line is colored blue, the DeepSpeed line is orange, and the H2O line is green. The plot shows that the Accelerate method has the highest GPU memory usage, followed by DeepSpeed and H2O. The plot also includes data points at the start and end of the x-axis, as well as any peaks, declines, or steady trends.
